“Perceived time expansion and compression correlate with information processing in an enumeration task.”
time perception is correlated with information processing in an enumeration task.

(a) the amount of time required to process information in a unit of space is increased when the number of items in that unit is increased (b) the amount of information that can be processed in a unit time is increased when the duration of a stimulus is extended and (c) the amount of processing that occurs in a unit of either space or time is increased when time is perceived to be distorted.

how time is experienced and how this relates to information processing.
the relationship between time perception and information processing.
the relationship between time, attention and information processing.

the perception of time is subjective and can be influenced by various factors, such as attention, context, and information processing.

time perception is not just about time, but also about information processing.
